infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Planera needs access to your photo library so you can select a profile photo.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Planera uses your location to verify you've visited destinations and unlock travel achievements, show your position on the trip map, help you navigate to activities, and notify you when you are near a planned stop on your itinerary.
